# Fixed Asset Type (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Fixed Asset Type` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 3 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-ref-fixedassettype) | `GET /ref/fixedassettype?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={FixedAssetTypeID}&Name={Name}` |
| [POST](#post-ref-fixedassettype) | `POST /ref/fixedassettype` |
| [PUT](#put-ref-fixedassettype) | `PUT /ref/fixedassettype` |


Fixed Asset Type CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Fixed Asset Types
| Property              | Type     | Length | Required | Notes                 |
|:----------------------|----------|--------|----------|-----------------------|
| `FixedAssetTypeID`    | Guid     |        |          | Unique ID             |
| `Name`                | String   | 50     | Yes      | Fixed Asset Type name |
| `DepreciationMethod`  | String   | 255    | Yes      | Should be one of the following values: `No Depreciation`, `Straight Line`, `Declining Balance`, `Declining Balance (150%)`, `Declining Balance (200%)`, `Sum of the Years' Digits`, `Full Depreciation at Purchase` |
| `AveragingMethod`     | String   | 255    | Yes      | Should be one of the following values: `Full Month`, `Actual Days` |
| `Rate`                | Decimal  |        | Yes      | Rate (%). Unable to set if Effective Life attribute is set|
| `EffectiveLife`       | Decimal  |        | Yes      | Effective Life (Yrs). Unable to set if Rate attribute is set|
| `AssetAccountCode`    | Decimal  |        | Yes      | ChartOfAccount Code with Type == `FIXED` && Class == `ASSET` && Status == `ACTIVE` |
| `AccumulatedDepreciationAccountCode` | String || Yes | ChartOfAccount Code with Type == `FIXED` && Class == `ASSET` && Status == `ACTIVE` |
| `AssetAccountName`    | String   |        |          | `DisplayName` of the linked ChartOfAccount. Read-only. |
| `AccumulatedDepreciationAccountName` | String ||     | `DisplayName` of the linked ChartOfAccount. Read-only. |
| `DepreciationExpenseAccountName` | String   ||       | `DisplayName` of the linked ChartOfAccount. Read-only. |

## Fixed Asset Type

Path: `/ref/fixedassettype`

<a id="get-ref-fixedassettype"></a>
### GET /ref/fixedassettype?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={FixedAssetTypeID}&Name={Name}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `FixedAssetTypeID` (optional, Guid): Only return Fixed Asset Type with the specific ID
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return accounts that start with the specific name

  "Total": 3,
